# kern-grid-item



<!-- Auto Generated Below -->


## Overview

An item of a `kern-grid` with `columns` that spans several columns. `span-sm`, `span-md` and `span-lg` change the
span from 640, 960 and 1280 px grid width, e.g. `span="12" span-md="8"`: full width on small grids, two thirds
from 960 px. A span larger than the columns is cut to the row.

## Properties

| Property | Attribute | Description                              | Type                  | Default     |
| -------- | --------- | ---------------------------------------- | --------------------- | ----------- |
| `span`   | `span`    | Columns spanned.                         | `number`              | `1`         |
| `spanLg` | `span-lg` | Columns spanned from 1280 px grid width. | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` |
| `spanMd` | `span-md` | Columns spanned from 960 px grid width.  | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` |
| `spanSm` | `span-sm` | Columns spanned from 640 px grid width.  | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` |
